title: Fruit purchase system of equations
prompt: A shop sells apples for $2 each and oranges for $3 each. Jordan spent $17 total and bought 6 pieces of fruit. How many oranges did Jordan buy? Explain your reasoning.

metadata.notes: Correct answer: 1 apple and 5 oranges. Solving a + o = 6 and 2a + 3o = 17 gives a = 1, o = 5 (check: 2(1) + 3(5) = 17). Narrowed (2026-09-23, V2.6 Phase 1) to ask for oranges only, since exact_match can only verify one value - this does NOT reduce the reasoning challenge, since setting up and solving the same 2-equation system is required either way; only which of the two solved values gets reported changes. Converted from manual to exact_match.
